claim: Langkawi is Malaysia's first UNESCO Global Geopark, the first in Southeast Asia, built from four geoforest areas.
quote: Langkawi UNESCO Global Geopark... the first geopark in Southeast Asia.

claim: Panorama Langkawi operates the official SkyCab cable car up Gunung Machinchang with three stations to the Sky Bridge.
quote: SkyCab: Cable car experience with three stations (Base, Middle at 650m, Top at 708m)

claim: SkyCab 4-in-1 combo is RM80 adult; hours 09:30-18:00, Wednesdays from 12:00 for maintenance, with a full annual closure July 12-24.
quote: Hours: 09:30-18:00... Wednesdays operate from 12:00 PM (maintenance)... Annual Closure: July 12-24.

claim: The Sky Bridge is a 125 m curved cable-stayed pedestrian bridge with its deck 660 m above sea level on Gunung Mat Cincang.
quote: a 125-metre curved pedestrian cable-stayed bridge... deck is 660 metres above sea level at the peak of Gunung Mat Cincang.

claim: A Kilim Geoforest mangrove boat tour runs through limestone karst, sea caves and eagle-watching on the east coast.
quote: Kilim Geoforest Park mangrove tour... limestone karst... caves... eagles.

claim: Island-hopping boats visit Dayang Bunting, the Lake of the Pregnant Maiden, a freshwater lake on a marble island.
quote: Dayang Bunting Island... Lake of the Pregnant Maiden.

claim: Tanjung Rhu and Datai Bay are the quietest, most scenic beaches; Cenang is the busiest.
quote: Tanjung Rhu... Datai Bay... Pantai Cenang is the most popular and busiest beach.

claim: The best time to visit Langkawi is the dry season Nov-Mar; Sep-Oct is the wettest, to be avoided.
quote: The best time to visit Langkawi is during the dry season, between November and March... September and October are the wettest months.

claim: Langkawi's pasar malam (night market) rotates to a different village every day of the week, with cheap satay, char kway teow and snacks.
quote: a different night market location for each day of the week.

claim: The Hole in the Wall floating fish-farm restaurant sits deep in the Kilim mangroves, reached by longtail boat.
quote: Floating Restaurant & Fish Breeding Farm... Hole in the Wall.

claim: Langkawi is duty-free: chocolate is ~50% off KL prices and spirits a third-to-a-sixth, with beer very cheap.
quote: Chocolate can be around 50% off compared to KL supermarkets, while certain brands of spirits can be a third or even a sixth of the price... beer is very cheap.

claim: Open-air Chinese-Muslim seafood in Kuah feeds a family of four for roughly RM120 including beer thanks to duty-free prices.
quote: a family of four can eat very well... around RM120 including beer.

claim: Kota Mahsuri is the cultural complex and mausoleum built around the legend of Mahsuri and her white-blood curse.
quote: Kota Mahsuri... the tomb of Mahsuri.

claim: Atma Alam Batik Art Village offers batik-painting workshops where visitors decorate their own cloth.
quote: Atma Alam Batik Art Village... paint your own batik.

claim: Galeria Perdana displays 9,000+ state gifts presented to former PM Mahathir Mohamad.
quote: Galeria Perdana... gifts and awards received by... Tun Dr Mahathir Mohamad.

claim: Feeding eagles chicken skin disrupts their hunting instincts and causes dependency, disease and aggression; pick observation-only operators.
quote: feeding them chicken skin is harmful... It disrupts their natural hunting instincts and makes them dependent on tourists.

claim: The direct Penang-Langkawi ferry no longer runs; arrive by a 1-hour flight or a ~1h15 ferry from Kuala Perlis.
quote: The Penang to Langkawi ferry service... no longer operating.

claim: Grab exists on Langkawi but is thin; the island runs on cheap car hire (left-hand traffic) and fixed-price coupon taxis.
quote: Grab is available in Langkawi but the supply of drivers is limited... taxis use fixed coupon prices.

claim: The Langkawi-Koh Lipe (Thailand) ferry runs seasonally, roughly October to early June only, with immigration at both ends.
quote: The Langkawi to Koh Lipe ferry operates seasonally from October to early June.

claim: Pulau Payar Marine Park is a full-day snorkel/dive trip ~45 min south of Kuah; it closes Tuesdays and Wednesdays and entirely March 1-May 31.
quote: closed every Tuesday and Wednesday for conservation, and closed from March 1 to May 31 every year.

claim: In 2026 the euro trades around 4.6-4.7 Malaysian ringgit.
quote: EUR/MYR 2026... approximately 4.7.

claim: Temple Tree (and sister Bon Ton) are restored antique kampung and heritage houses re-erected on-site near Cenang.
quote: eight unique heritage homes, lovingly restored... Chinese, Malay, Indian and Eurasian styles.

claim: A common recommendation is to split a longer stay between lively Cenang and a quiet resort in Tanjung Rhu or Datai Bay.
quote: stay for three nights at Pantai Cenang... then three nights at a quiet resort in Tanjung Rhu or Datai Bay.

claim: LIMA, the Langkawi maritime-and-aerospace exhibition, is biennial; the next edition runs 20-24 April 2027, with no 2026 edition.
The abandoned Lagenda Langkawi theme park in Kuah is a quirky urbex stop built around island legends.
quote: Lagenda Langkawi... abandoned theme park.

claim: Duty-free beer on Langkawi drops to about RM6, making the island notably cheaper than mainland Malaysia.
quote: beer prices are as low as $1.51 / RM5.97... significantly more affordable than mainland Malaysia.
